'''Tatyana Mikhailovna Frunze''' ([[Russian language|Russian]]: Татьяна Михайловна Фрунзе; 2 August 1920 – 15 January 2024) was a Soviet and Russian organic chemist, Doctor of Chemical Sciences, professor (1969). She was the daughter of [[Mikhail Frunze]].

== Early life and career ==
Frunze was born into the family of People's Commissar of Military and Naval Affairs [[Mikhail Frunze]]. After the death of her father (1925) and mother (1926), together with her younger brother [[Timur Frunze|Timur]], she lived with her grandmother for some time, and after her death, the children were adopted by family friend [[Klim Voroshilov]].<ref>{{Cite web |title="Хочу быть похороненным на Красной площади…" // В. Эрлихман, Родина, № 416 (4) |date=24 April 2016 |url=https://rg.ru/2016/04/24/rodina-voroshilov.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190402132141/https://rg.ru/2016/04/24/rodina-voroshilov.html |archive-date=2 April 2019}}</ref>

According to the memoirs of [[Semyon Budyonny]], she studied at the [[NBC Protection Military Academy|Military Academy of Chemical Defense of the Red Army]], and during the war she worked at one of the tank factories.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Семен |first=Будённый |title=Пройдённый путь. Книга третья |publisher=Воениздат |year=1973 |location=М. |chapter=}}</ref> As of 10 October 1945, she served at the academy with the rank of lieutenant technician.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Акт вручения награжденным медалей за победу над Германией в ВОВ 1941—1945 гг., стр. 17 п. 229 |url=http://podvignaroda.ru/#id=1560369405&tab=navDetailDocument |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100414154437/http://podvignaroda.ru/#id=1560369405&tab=navDetailDocument |archive-date=14 April 2010}}</ref>

In 1947 she graduated from the Moscow [[D. Mendeleev University of Chemical Technology of Russia|University of Chemical Technology]]  (graduate of the Department of Chemistry and Technology of Organic Synthesis).<ref>{{Cite web |title=История кафедры Химии и Технологии Органического Синтеза на сайте РХТУ |url=http://www.muctr.ru/univsubs/infacol/hft/faculties/f4/history.php |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170124161658/http://www.muctr.ru/univsubs/infacol/hft/faculties/f4/history.php |archive-date=24 January 2017}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |title=Выпускники Российского химико-технологического университета им. Д.И. Менделеева 1906–1950 |publisher=РХТУ им. Д.И. Менделеева |year=2001 |isbn=5-7237-0321-8 |location=Москва |pages=124}}</ref> Then she worked at the N. D. Zelinsky Institute of Organic Chemistry, carried out research on the chemistry of polyamides, and defended her [[Candidate of Sciences]] thesis on this topic.

In 1954, she moved to the newly founded [[Nesmeyanov Institute of Organoelement Compounds|Institute of Organoelement Compounds]], and a few years later she defended her doctoral dissertation on the topic “Research in the field of synthetic heterochain polyamides.” (Исследование в области синтетических гетероцепных полиамидов). In 1964, she headed the newly created laboratory of polymerization processes at the institute.<ref>{{Cite book |title=Институт элементоорганических соединений имени А. Н. Несмеянова: История и современность / РАН. Ин-т элементоорган. соединений им. А. Н. Несмеянова; Отв. ред.: М. И. Кабачник, Ю. Н. Бубнов. — М.: Наука, 1999, стр. 227 | date=1999 | publisher=Наука | isbn=9785020044081 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=I3mQAAAAIAAJ&q=%22%D1%82.+%D0%BC.+%D1%84%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B7%D0%B5%22+ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202000929/https://books.google.ru/books?hl=ru&id=I3mQAAAAIAAJ&dq=%22%D1%82.+%D0%BC.+%D1%84%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B7%D0%B5%22+%D0%BB%D0%B0%D0%B1%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B0%D1%82%D0%BE%D1%80%D0%B8%D1%8F&focus=searchwithinvolume&q=%22%D1%82.+%D0%BC.+%D1%84%D1%80%D1%83%D0%BD%D0%B7%D0%B5%22+ |archive-date=2 February 2017}}</ref>

For several years she was a member of the Expert Council of the [[Higher Attestation Commission]] on Organic Chemistry and a member of the Council on Macromolecular Compounds under the Presidium of the [[USSR Academy of Sciences]].

In addition to scientific work, she was engaged in social work: from 1968 to 1991 she was deputy chairman of the [[Committee of Soviet Women]]. She also took part in preserving the legacy of M. V. Frunze.<ref>{{Cite web |title=94-летняя дочь Михаила Фрунзе готова приехать в Бишкек на юбилей отца // А. Тузов, «Вечерний Бишкек», 07 января 2015 |date=7 January 2015 |url=http://www.vb.kg/doc/298731_94_letniaia_doch_mihaila_frynze_gotova_priehat_v_bishkek_na_ubiley_otca.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202003026/http://www.vb.kg/doc/298731_94_letniaia_doch_mihaila_frynze_gotova_priehat_v_bishkek_na_ubiley_otca.html |archive-date=2 February 2017}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
[[File:Татьяна_Фрунзе.jpg|thumb|right|Tatyana Frunze in military uniform]]

Tatyana Frunze's husband was [[Colonel general|Colonel General]] Anatoly Georgievich Pavlov (1920–2007). Son Timur Anatolyevich Pavlov (1944–2008) (named in honor of Tatyana Mikhailovna’s brother) and daughter Elena Anatolyevna Pavlova (born 1948) are also [[Chemist|chemical scientists]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Женщины из рода Фрунзе // В. Букеева, «Слово Кыргызстана», 8 марта 2013 |url=http://slovo.kg/?p=18986 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202002309/http://slovo.kg/?p=18986 |archive-date=2 February 2017}}</ref> She also has grandchildren and great-grandchildren.

In December 2008, Tatyana Frunze’s apartment was robbed, including Mikhail Frunze’s awards. The thieves who had gained the trust of Tatyana Frunze were found, and a number of valuables were returned.<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 January 2010 |title=Нашли преступников, обокравших дочь Михаила Фрунзе |url=https://rg.ru/2010/01/29/vory.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230405235812/https://rg.ru/2010/01/29/vory.html |archive-date=5 April 2023}}</ref>

As of April 2020, she lived in Moscow with her daughter Elena.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Дочь Михаила Фрунзе готовится к своему 100-летию и передает привет Бишкеку |date=27 April 2020 |url=https://www.vb.kg/doc/387559_doch_mihaila_frynze_gotovitsia_k_svoemy_100_letiu_i_peredaet_privet_bishkeky.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201029104455/https://www.vb.kg/doc/387559_doch_mihaila_frynze_gotovitsia_k_svoemy_100_letiu_i_peredaet_privet_bishkeky.html |archive-date=29 October 2020}}</ref> In August 2020, she celebrated her 100th birthday.<ref>{{Cite web |date=4 August 2020 |title=Потомки Фрунзе не потерялись во времени |url=https://shuya.bezformata.com/listnews/potomki-frunze-ne-poteryalis-vo-vremeni/86145612/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230405234554/https://shuya.bezformata.com/listnews/potomki-frunze-ne-poteryalis-vo-vremeni/86145612/ |archive-date=5 April 2023}}</ref>

Frunze died in [[Moscow]] on 15 January 2024, at the age of 103.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://muzeyfrunze.ru/item/1762160|title=Не стало Татьяны Михайловны Фрунзе|language=ru|website=muzeyfrunze.ru|date=2024-01-17|publisher=Шуйский историко-художественный и мемориальный музей им. М.В. Фрунзе г.о. Шуя}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mkivanovo.ru/social/2024/01/19/15-yanvarya-v-vozraste-103-let-skonchalas-doch-sovetskogo-polkovodca-mikhaila-frunze.html|title=15 января в возрасте 103 лет скончалась дочь советского полководца Михаила Фрунзе|language=ru|website=mkivanovo.ru|date=2024-01-19|publisher=Московский Комсомолец (МК) в Иваново}}</ref>

== Awards ==
* [[Order of the Red Banner of Labour|Order of the Red Banner of Labor]]
* [[Order of Friendship of Peoples]] (16 January 1981)
* [[Order of the Badge of Honour]] (30 December 1990)
* [[Medal "For the Victory over Germany in the Great Patriotic War 1941–1945"|Medal "For the victory over Germany in the Great Patriotic War of 1941–1945"]] (1945)
* Medal "Nairamdal" (Friendship) (Mongolian People's Republic)
* other medals.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Татьяна Михайловна Фрунзе (к 60-летию со дня рождения) // Высокомолекулярные соединения, 1981, т. 23 Серия А, № 4. — С. 954—955. |url=http://polymsci.ru/static/Archive/1981/VMS_1981_T23_4/VMS_1981_T23_4_954-955.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170201233807/http://polymsci.ru/static/Archive/1981/VMS_1981_T23_4/VMS_1981_T23_4_954-955.pdf |archive-date=1 February 2017}}</ref>

== Scientific research ==
Frunze's scientific interests were related to the chemistry of macromolecular compounds. She studied [[polycondensation]] reactions, in particular those occurring during the synthesis of polyamides, together with her colleagues she obtained many new polyamides (for example, caprolite<ref>{{Cite web |title=Капролит-РМ — новый конструкционный материал // «Пластические массы», № 9, 1976 |url=http://viam.ru/public/files/1975/1975-196983.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170202021044/http://viam.ru/public/files/1975/1975-196983.pdf |archive-date=2 February 2017}}</ref> and declon) and, based on a study of the dependence of the properties of these compounds on their structure, proposed a concept that allows these properties to be changed as needed. In addition, she studied the polymerization of [[Vinyl record|vinyl compounds]] and heterocycles.<ref name=":0" />

Author of the monograph “Synthetic heterochain polyamides” (1962, together with Vasiliy Korshak), a large number of scientific papers, and several inventions.
